title: Freshness of the initial configuration
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathrm{dec}:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input. In the initial configuration of the amplified machine on $x$, every work tape in a block with positive block index is blank everywhere and has its head at cell $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
